blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — It’s better late than never for the ZUS Coffee Thunderbelles as they finally found their footing to end their woes in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. Already out of contention after a 0-5 start, ZUS Coffee refused to give up from two sets down to oust Galeries Tower, 17-25, 21-25, 25-20, 25-20, 15-12, on Tuesday night at Smart Araneta Coliseum. AC Miner, who returned to her original middle blocker position in the last three sets to finish with 17 points off 13 kills and four blocks, was relieved to finally end their struggles, admitting that they lacked […]...
